question: Who is the head of the Union Executive of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The President**__**.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The President is the head of the State and the Union Executive (Article 52).
 
• Elected by an Electoral College consisting of MPs and MLAs through proportional representation by single transferable vote (Article 54).
 
• Holds office for 5 years and can be re-elected (Article 56).
 
• Exercises executive, legislative, judicial, and emergency powers with the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers (Articles 72, 123, 356).
 
• The Prime Minister is the** head of the Union Executive of the Government of India**
 
• The Prime Minister is **appointed by the President.**
 
• Other ministers shall be appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister.
 
• He is also the head of the council of ministers.
 
• **Article 74 to Article 78 of Part V** deals with the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers.
 
• He is the chairman of the cabinet and presides over the meetings of the Cabinet.</li&g
